thought: The main error is that action_2 (Slack message post) is called with empty params, which causes the workflow to have issues and fail execution. We need to provide complete and correct params for action_2, especially setting the channel and the text parameter with the correct expression to extract the message text from input_data. Similarly, action_4 (Gmail send) also has empty params and should be fixed to include required parameters with proper expressions. action_3 (second AI completion) params are fine as empty because AI completion reads from input_data only. We'll fix action_2 and action_4 params to ensure the workflow can run without errors.
plan: Update action_2 params to include select='channel', channelId with mode 'name' and value 'general', messageType='text', and text with expression '={{$json["text"]}}'.
Update action_4 params to include sendTo, subject, emailType='text', and message with expressions to extract from input_data.
Test the workflow after these fixes to ensure Slack messages and emails are sent correctly.
criticism: Current action_2 and action_4 params are empty, which causes execution failure. This is a critical issue that prevents the workflow from running. Fixing these params is necessary for successful execution.
